# file: internal/plugins/maintenance/testdata/fixer_stores_allowlist.txt
# version: 1.4.0
# guid: 6a3e8d21-9c47-4f15-b2e0-1d7c5a9f3b68
# last-edited: 2026-11-13
#
# Reviewed exceptions for TestFixerStores_NoFixerReachesAStoreExceptThroughTheShell
# (fixer_stores_guard_test.go; the pass is tools/fixerstores).
#
# Format, one per line:   kind name # reason
#   store-sink <function> <accessor>   a FixerStores accessor a fixer reaches on a
#                           receiver that is not a store-family interface, or a
#                           conversion into one (convert:From->To), in <function>.
#                           Keyed on both: a new accessor in the same function is a
#                           new report.
#   dep <Method>            a ServerDeps method, not one of the 15 accessors, that
#                           a fixer reaches through the plugin's captured deps
#   unresolved <caller> -> <callee>   a func argument the pass cannot follow
# The reason is required. An entry the pass no longer reports fails the test
# (delete it), so this file only shrinks. Adding a line is a review decision,
# not a way to make the test pass: a fixer that reads a store through the
# plugin's deps reads HEAD's store, not the one the native shell bound to ctx.

# ---- store sinks
store-sink (*Plugin).fixerStores convert:pluginFixerStores->FixerStores # the fallback for a caller that runs a fixer without the shell (HEAD's repairs.plan / repairs.apply ops and the fixers' own tests); the native shell always binds the stores (KindDeps.BindStores is required) and fixerStores answers from ctx first. TestFixers_FallBackToPluginStoresWithoutShell covers it. Goes with the HEAD path

# ---- deps that are not stores
dep RootDir # the configured library root, a string; nothing is read or written through it
dep EnqueueOp # AfterApply follow-ups enqueue another operation by definition id; the queue is not one of FixerStores' accessors
dep InvalidateDedupCache # drops an in-memory cache after series rows changed; reads and writes no store
dep InvalidateSeriesCache # drops an in-memory cache after series rows changed; reads and writes no store
dep AcquireScanStandDown # reached from versionGroupPrimaryRepair only when params.Apply is set (repairs.AcquireStandDownWaiting); vgPrimaryFixer.Plan passes a dry run, and the shell holds the stand-down through rc.StandDown
dep RenewScanStandDown # the same legacy stand-down lease, renewed inside versionGroupPrimaryRepair only when params.Apply is set (scanStandDownLostForApply, ScanStandDownHold.Beat); Plan passes a dry run

# ---- deps that read a store the shell does not hand out. These are real reads
# ---- through the plugin's own deps, not the shell's; they are listed, not
# ---- excused. See seams.d/F5-02.md, "Owner questions", for what moving them costs.
dep BookIDsWithIdentifiers # versionTwinFixer.readersVia binds it from f.p.deps: a read-only identifier index lookup; not one of FixerStores' 15
dep BooksWithMetadataSourceHash # versionTwinFixer.readersVia binds it from f.p.deps: a read-only book lookup by metadata source hash; not one of FixerStores' 15
dep BooksWithMetadataSourceHashInMemory # versionTwinFixer.readersVia binds it from f.p.deps: the in-memory variant of the hash lookup; not one of FixerStores' 15
dep CachedMetadataCandidates # junkTitleFixer.candidateTitleVia reads one book's metadata candidate cache entry through f.p.deps; not one of FixerStores' 15
dep LatestCandidateFetchOutcome # lostCandidatesFixer.Replan reads one book's last candidate fetch outcome through f.p.deps; not one of FixerStores' 15
dep LatestCandidateFetchOutcomes # lostCandidatesFixer.Plan reads every book's last candidate fetch outcome through f.p.deps; not one of FixerStores' 15
dep LatestReconcileScan # reconcileFixer.Plan reads the latest reconcile scan through f.p.deps; not one of FixerStores' 15

# ---- a service call, not a store
dep RefetchMetadataCandidates # lostCandidatesFixer.Apply runs the provider chain and writes the candidate cache through f.p.deps; no FixerStores accessor or repairs.Writer path covers it. Owner question 1 in seams.d/F5-02.md

# ---- func values read from struct fields or returned by a call the pass cannot
# ---- see through (the limit the header of the test states), bare or inside a
# ---- struct literal. Each is a plain injected function, set by the constructor to a
# ---- standard-library function and swapped by tests. Keyed on caller, callee and
# ---- the argument's description.
unresolved (*consolidationLeftoversFixer).Apply -> github.com/falkcorp/audiobook-organizer/internal/plugins/maintenance.retireIntoExpecting [field consolidationLeftoversFixer.now] # f.now, the clock: time.Now from newConsolidationLeftoversFixer
unresolved (*duplicateCopiesFixer).Apply -> github.com/falkcorp/audiobook-organizer/internal/plugins/maintenance.retireIntoAllowingITunesPath [field duplicateCopiesFixer.now] # f.now, the clock: time.Now from newDuplicateCopiesFixer
unresolved (*duplicateCopiesFixer).detailVia -> (github.com/falkcorp/audiobook-organizer/internal/versionprimary.Loader).Load [load of versionprimary.Loader] # a Loader literal whose Stat is f.statFn: os.Stat from newDuplicateCopiesFixer
unresolved (*fragmentFixer).retire -> github.com/falkcorp/audiobook-organizer/internal/plugins/maintenance.retireIntoITunesDatabaseOnly [field fragmentFixer.now] # f.now, the clock: time.Now from newFragmentFixer
unresolved (*fragmentFixer).hashCopyGate -> github.com/falkcorp/audiobook-organizer/internal/plugins/maintenance.fileSig [field fragmentFixer.statFn] # f.statFn: os.Stat from newFragmentFixer
unresolved (*retiredRun).ownerManual -> github.com/falkcorp/audiobook-organizer/internal/repairs.GuardOwnerManualBooks [field retiredRun.series] # r.series: the series-name lookup retiredShared builds with repairs.SeriesNamesFrom over a series listing read when the run's shared state is built
unresolved (*vgPrimaryFixer).Plan -> (*github.com/falkcorp/audiobook-organizer/internal/plugins/maintenance.Plugin).versionGroupPrimaryRepair [result of (*vgPrimaryFixer).prober] # f.prober(...): f.probe when a test set one, else versionprimary.FFprobeChapterCounter, an ffprobe counter that reads no store
unresolved (*vgPrimaryFixer).Replan -> (*github.com/falkcorp/audiobook-organizer/internal/plugins/maintenance.vgApplier).planGroup [load of versionprimary.Loader] # a Loader literal whose Probe is f.prober(...): f.probe when a test set one, else the ffprobe counter, which reads no store
